instrument: Public notice, City of Sanford and Lee County
summary: Sanford and Lee County declined to adopt a moratorium, stating in a public notice that doing so would create a legal quagmire, and updated their development rules instead.
notes: Recorded because a documented decision not to use an instrument, with a stated reason, is as informative for comparison as an adoption. Neighbouring North Carolina jurisdictions adopted moratoria in the same period: Cary 18 months from late August with an ordinance decision due February 2028, Apex 12 months to April 2027, Wendell through December 2026, Harnett County one year from May 2026.
confidence_note: The public notice has not been read. The legal quagmire characterization is quoted from reporting and no legal analysis underlying it has been located.
